Synopsis:
    Democratic candidate Gina Hinojosa is challenging Republican Governor Greg Abbott in the 2026 Texas gubernatorial race, targeting Latino voters with an economic/pocketbook message. Despite a massive fundraising disadvantage ($3M vs $67.2M cash-on-hand), Hinojosa polls within 4 points statewide. The race tests whether Democratic inroads with Latino voters on cost-of-living, education, and housing can overcome Abbott's entrenched political machine, Trump endorsement, and 30-year Republican statewide dominance.
